label: S6520X-30QC-EI
description: H3C S6520X-30QC-EI - 24x 1G/10G SFP+ ports + 2x 40GE QSFP+ (split into 4x 10GE each), 2 expansion slots, IRF/VXLAN aggregation switch.
notes: The 24 template ports are declared sfp+ explicitly: at 10G both copper (10GBASE-T) and fibre (SFP+) are common, so the connector must not be guessed from the rate.
